verdict.rationale: The product ships its own Python client (edison-client) with API-token authentication. It can submit tasks programmatically via create_task/acreate_task, block on completion with run_tasks_until_done, and batch-submit jobs to query later. That is a documented headless automation path with no UI required. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline guidance (e.g., env-var auth, CI examples), a CLI or published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended use.
